crossRefs.note: So Abram went, as Yahweh had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom…
After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:
Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”
He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Haran
people.line: Son of Terah, brother of Abraham and father of Lot.

people.name: Nahor
people.line: Son of Terah, Abraham's brother; father of Bethuel.

people.name: Terah
people.line: Abraham's father who settled in Haran

translations.web: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
translations.bsb: When Terah was 70 years old, he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
translations.kjv: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
translations.asv: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
